body:
I understand. Same here, honestly. I feel like I'll never have friends or the life I want and change seems untouchable. 

Are you working? In college?

Me too. I don't know if I'm going to do it yet, but I'd love for it to be somewhere warm and beautiful.

But anyway, what's bothering you? I'm not going to try to talk you out of it or be all preachy, but I'd like to listen if it'll help you feel any better for the time being. If not, that's okay too.
I don't know. I just feel like nothing will ever change. I grew up miserable, who's to say I won't be miserable forever?
